Net income was $(53,197) for the period Apr. 10–Jun. 30, 2026 (consolidated net loss).
Diluted EPS was $(0.01) for the period Apr. 10–Jun. 30, 2026 (basic and diluted net loss per Class B share).

Has established administrative services, sponsor support and governance to pursue and evaluate business combinations.
Operating as an early-stage blank-check company with no revenue to date and actively pursuing business combinations within its combination period while preparing for potential post-merger operations.
